caption: The drawing depicts a single mortar and pestle set placed centrally on a neutral, light beige background. The mortar is cylindrical with a flared rim and a sturdy, rounded base, and the pestle is partially inside the mortar, angled diagonally with the rounded end protruding above the rim. Both the mortar and pestle have a metallic, bronze-brown coloration with varied shading and highlights suggesting a worn, aged surface. There are visible texture details that indicate tarnishing or patina on both objects. Shadows within and around the objects suggest a light source from the top left. There is a faint inscription or signature in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Brass Mortar and Pestle
